meta.description: Station and node data for the corridor + alternative network. Coordinates are official LandsD iGeoCom RSN station points (HK grid transformed via the official Geodetic Survey API); names, line membership, stop order and station accessibility verified field-level against MTR open-data CSV on 2026-09-25. Segment times elsewhere remain real-derived estimates.
meta.provenance_note: Record-level provenance is 'real-derived': names/lines/order/accessibility rows are official MTR CSV evidence; coordinates are official iGeoCom RSN points, not asserted surveyed centroids. The earlier claim that coordinates came from 'MTR open data' was incorrect (that CSV has no coordinates) and was removed. See data/PROVENANCE.md S23/S25/S30. Station-level facility rows do not establish per-entrance step-free paths, walk connectivity, or live lift service state.
